hints.title: Halving Array Simulation
hints.text: At each step, create an array of half the length by pairing adjacent elements.

hints.title: Alternating Min and Max Operations
hints.text: For even index i, new element is min(nums[2 * i], nums[2 * i + 1]). For odd index i, it is max(nums[2 * i], nums[2 * i + 1]).

hints.title: Termination on Single Element
hints.text: Repeat the halving reduction until length becomes 1.

hints.title: Alternating Tournament Simulation Implementation

complexity.notes: Geometric series: n + n/2 + n/4 + ... = 2n total operations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: No complex failure mode; iterative halving runs in linear time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary list recreation per round.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate simulates the reduction round cleanly with alternating min/max logic.
